title: The last on-call
one_sentence_promise: Some pages are not incidents. They are goodbyes.

beats.purpose: A night the pager meant something else
beats.one_idea: The last message was not a stack trace.

turns.speaker: leo
turns.text: [inhale] I kept the pager on the night she left the company. I thought it would be a config drift. [long-pause] It was a goodbye.

turns.speaker: ara
turns.text: <soft>You do not have to make it a joke.</soft> [sigh] We can just say it. [cry]

turns.speaker: leo
turns.text: <decrease-intensity><lower-pitch>Yeah. That's the last thing she said.</lower-pitch></decrease-intensity>

meta.purpose: Proves cry/sigh/decrease-intensity stay in the general kit. Will fail preset roberto-agent skip-list on purpose.
